name: matlab-configure-java
description: Check which Java version MATLAB is using, switch it, or reset it without accidentally starting Java. Use this skill when a user wants to determine which Java/JDK/JRE version MATLAB is using, configure MATLAB to use a different JDK, or revert to the MATLAB default Java, or when a MATLAB script errors on a java.* API call ("no runtime environment for Java applications has been found", "Unable to find Java library"). Covers jenv and matlab_jenv, R2025a+ dynamic loading, restart requirements based on Java load status, and release- and platform-specific reset behavior. Also handles installing OpenJDK (the MATLAB Add-Ons Explorer, Adoptium, or a command-line mpm install through matlab-core:matlab-install-products).
